author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In this AI era, you can't tell someone is working hard or just lucky. 

You can't tell the difference between someone hitting a vibe coding jackpot, the AI gets something done on the first try, then he slacks off for the next 3 days or someone battling with AI to make it behave for 3 straight days.
